name: Jellyxtream
overview: Xtream IPTV: movies, series and Live TV as native Jellyfin content
description: Integrates Xtream-compatible IPTV providers. Movies and series become native libraries (STRM), Live TV is a native tuner with EPG. Provider-friendly by design: one shared request budget, classified errors and an automatic pause instead of request storms. Fork of firestaerter3/Jellyfin-Xtream-Library (GPL-3.0-or-later).

versions.changelog:
- Release tooling: publishing to the public plugin repository works when it is still empty.
  No functional change to the plugin (first update published through the catalog).

First release of the Jellyxtream fork (based on Jellyfin Xtream Library 1.55.3.0, release/1.x).

- New plugin identity (name "Jellyxtream", own GUID and configuration file). The configuration of
  the original "Xtream Library" plugin is imported on first start and left unchanged.
- Provider-friendly client: one request budget per provider for all plugin components
  (default 2 concurrent requests), Retry-After honoured, no retries on 401/403/404, automatic pause
  after repeated refusals or dropped connections, single test request to resume.
- Clear connection test results: wrong credentials (auth = 0), HTTP status, dropped connection and
  timeout are reported separately; no credentials in log messages.
- No orphan deletion after an incomplete provider fetch; only one sync runs at a time.
- Diagnostics endpoint `XtreamLibrary/Diagnostics/Providers` (sanitised request log).
- Fix: ratings were misread on servers with a German locale.
- Artwork URLs of hosts that do not accept connections are no longer written to NFO files (a dead
  provider image host made library scans wait 21 s per item); checked once per host, cached.
- New provider option "Remove leading country code" ("AL - Title" -> "Title"), on by default, off for
  configurations imported from the original plugin. Improves metadata matching considerably.
